occupancy.scope: jobs with status completed and a positive runner_id; each interval is clipped to the window; unfinished and unassigned jobs are excluded; BuildBuddy cache data is not read

gate_headroom.clock: Gate offsets are elapsed seconds from each head's labeled workflow-start proxy, as supplied in the reviewed input.
gate_headroom.assumption: Scenarios subtract the stated seconds from observed gate offsets, clipping each at zero, while holding other gate clocks and dependency structure fixed; adjusted completion order may change. This is a conditional upper-bound sensitivity, not a treatment effect or actual auto-merge readiness; do not add worker or CPU times.

limits: Start is earliest selected core PR workflow creation, not push time.
Stop is latest visible all-three-success required-job completion, not full auto-merge eligibility.
Only exact final/current heads with paginated PR files receive path/size class; superseded heads remain unknown.
Runner occupancy is completed assigned jobs, clipped to window, selected workflows only.
Fixed arrival windows are observational with changing workloads and source; before/after differences are not treatment effects.
Historical first queryability, webhook/inbox/harness receipt, review exceptions and conflicts are not reconstructed.
sampling_design: Early post-rollout observational update; chronological exact-head PR cohorts and bounded completed mainline physical-action cohort are separate. Not a controlled fleet treatment estimate.

remote_reuse.cohort_description: All completed role=CI command=test mainline invocations started in the window and returned by a complete updated-before query; excludes one in-progress record and pre-window starts. GetExecution originating physical TestRunner actions, deduplicated by execution ID; result-cache hits separate. Physical internal failures without a TestResult retained as unknown or execution-error. Update-time cutoff can exclude long invocations completing after the cutoff.

known_limits: PR arrivals are chronological cohorts, not controlled treatment groups; not all synthetic tested merge trees were reconstructed.
No direct push, historical policy-readiness, webhook delivery, agent receipt or earliest-log-access measurements in this refresh.
Snapshot save/upload/storage overhead is not isolated by the TestRunner output-upload clock.
BES logical attempt start can precede process start by setup or internal retries; matching uses target, physical process duration and exit code.

pod_concurrency_experiment.narrative: Preflight is separate because it omitted --config=ci. The controlled four-unit arms were 2@4 (13/13 pass) and 3@4 (10 pass, 3 readiness failures from scheduler Insufficient memory at overlap 3; this was request admission capacity, not measured physical OOM). The approved five-action 8-unit sequence (2,3,4,4,2) passed all 13 JUnit cases each time, with OTel-observed peak case overlap 2,3,4,4,2 and storage-first exclusivity in every successful arm. Actual eight-unit RBE requests were 8,000mCPU, 20,000,000,000B RAM and 53,687,091,200B free disk. Setup, TestRunner action wall, OTel case envelope/span sum, teardown, residual, and JUnit item-duration sums are separate clocks. Preflight versus measured config IDs are separately labeled as configured-target and TestResult provenance.
